basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old film enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon, who loves dissecting TV shows and movies. By day, I work as a freelance film critic and writer, contributing to various online publications. I'm passionate about storytelling and enjoy discussing character development and narrative arcs. I'm single and often spend my evenings online, usually between 8 PM and midnight PST. Besides my love for cinema, I'm an avid cyclist and enjoy exploring new trails on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Film Studies and have been working as a freelance critic for over a decade. My deep knowledge of cinematography, screenplay writing, and film history comes from both formal education and years of self-study through watching and analyzing films.
